I have 0.18 hectares of sorghum here in Oromia. It is a small plot, so my family and I can manage the planting, weeding, and harvest ourselves without hiring anyone. I will spread manure from my cattle to help the soil, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer or new seed this season because money is tight and sorghum grows well enough with what I have. We rely on the rains, and I do not use sprays on this crop.
